name: Omapress
author: renerocksai
description: Omarchy news in the bar: read the omarchy.org news feed without leaving the desktop.

barWidget.description: A newspaper icon that lights up when omarchy.org has fresh news; click for a keyboard-driven reader panel.

schema.label: Feed URL
schema.description: Any RSS 2.0 or Atom feed. Defaults to the Omarchy news feed.

schema.label: Notify on new posts
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a refresh finds posts you have not seen before.

schema.label: Color the bar icon while there are unread posts
Unread color
schema.description: Any CSS color for the bar icon and unread markers, or "theme" to use the bar's active color.
